notes.title: 1.5.0 Shop patch
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]

Hope you are doing fine. Here is a fresh patch for you!

[h2]Shop and Coins[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44033425/aa9675b9c0ceb0b9b655a074fe67ef926b1905e3.png[/img]

Added coins that can drop after either destroying vases or defeating monsters.
Coins are persistent between rounds, and can only be spent at the start of a round in the new shop.
You can buy strength, mushlings and health, so you have to be smart what to spend them on!

[h2]New enemy[/h2]

[h3]Buff pot[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44033425/d75c3045919a21f1cf65cf5b4ea710dafdcc9460.png[/img]

A slightly stronger pot that can spawn on higher ascensions, to make up to the fact that you now earn gold in vases. 

[h2]Balance updates[/h2]

[h3]Mimic[/h3]
Cooldown 3 -> 4
Attack 3 -> 2
It's just too punishing if you battle with it early in a run, so I nerfed it across the board

- Increased the boss health slightly on higher ascensions

[h2]Small changes[/h2]
- Added a "dizzy indicator" when hitting enemies to tell you that they won't attack next turn
- Added bullet trails for board bullets
- Updated UI for holding a key
- Start showing the board UI on the starting floor
- Destroy all spawned monsters on round won
- Fix bug with bestiary not updating correctly

[i]/ Sebastian[/i]

notes.title: 1.4.0 Welcome back
notes.content:
Hi again!

A big patch coming up!

[h1]New additions![/h1]
- 3 new rooms with new art and gameplay
- 2 new mushlings
- 2 new enemies

[h1]Balance changes[/h1]
- More breathing room between enemies on first floor (Ascension 1)
- Slightly lower enemy spawn-rate on higher floors
- On your first real encounter a warning will be shown that enemies will hurt you if you let them past you (Ascension 1, zero losses)

[h2]Upgrades[/h2]
- You gain five more health, but lose a random mushling - > You gain four more health, but lose a random mushling

[h2]Towers[/h2]
- Testling cooldown 4 -> 3
- Magnetling hp 6 -> 7, cooldown 2 -> 3

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
- Weird Merchant health 7 -> 8

[h1]General changes[/h1]
- Draw the damage values on the enemy that flees instead of on the player character
- Added a dark border and a heart to damage values to make them more readable and visible
- Gnomes are moving towards you if it's the first time playing (so you don't miss the tutorial)
- Improve some text
- Fix weird bug that caused the boss to spawn on your new run before the boss floor

- Increase the chance of weather effects spawning
- Improve how dust looks
- Improve how rain looks
- Improve how snow looks

[i]/ Sebastian[/i]

notes.title: 1.3.1 Patch
notes.content:
Hi!

Happy continuation of the new year!

[h3]Patch notes[/h3]

[b]- A "skip turn button" has been added[/b]
Press the switch mushling button when all the mushlings have been placed
[i](Unlocked it by winning with the second character once)[/i]

[b]Developer notes[/b]
During development I considered implementing this, but decided against it. Why you ask?

I am a bit afraid that it will be used too much, therefore putting you in a situation that could have been handled if you stayed calm and moved around the board. By putting it as an unlock, I can guarantee that you are ready to play the game faster.

[i]/ Sebastian[/i]

notes.title: 1.3.0 Tutorial Patch
notes.content:
Hi!

I really thought the last patch would be my last for this year, but then a big video was released from Vinesauce! 

[h2]Go check it out![/h2]
[previewyoutube=Y-w_Ai05duw;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]It made my year that's for sure![/b]

In the video I saw something he missed that could made his life a bit easier. [b]Dashing![/b]
This is the main mechanic for destroying exploding beasts, so you will need to know this skill. 

[h3]Patch notes[/h3]

- Improved the instruction how to teleport
- Added a completely new tutorial (access it by attacking a second gnome), teaching you how to dash. 
- Changed the description of exploding enemies to referencing dashing
- Added a new tankier gnome during the second tutorial to better showcasing the dash
- Changed the Scareling art[i](it did not look "mushroomy" enough)[/i]

[i]/ Sebastian[/i]

notes.title: 1.2.0 Bestiary patch
notes.content:
[h2]Hi![/h2]

Hope you are doing fine!
This is a huge patch, with new elements and balance changes!

[h2]Bestiary added[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44033425/41fb914910dbb5d2d56ff006e5c50e5d2f2cbb46.png[/img]

Each time you encounter new beasts you can read a bit about their behavior and stats. 
Hopefully this will help you overcome the challenging battles!

[h2]Battle music added[/h2]

Makes the battle scenario separate a bit better from the over world!

[h2]New beast[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44033425/121ac0c955fe1d5acd810d5e33d2eae69c545703.png[/img]

Wanted a new beast that forces you to move around, it's like a smarter slug!

[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

[h3]Mushlings[/h3]

[b]Buffs[/b]
- Svampling hp 4 -> 5
- Ozzling hp 3 -> 4
- Burnlings and Bomblings are immune against explosions

Some mushlings got some more health as they are tricky to handle.

[b]Nerfs[/b]
- Buffling hp 4 -> 3

With certain mushlings this could become a bit too strong, now you need to defend it more I hope.

[h3]Beasts[/h3]

[b]Berf[/b]
Cheerful pig
- Hp 3 -> 4
- Attack 2 -> 1

[b]Nerf[/b]
Hyper Deer
Hp 3 -> 2

This nerf will probably affect the gameplay the most as it is one of the first beasts you encounter in the game. Hopefully this makes it a little easier to reach the end game. 

[h3]General changes[/h3]
- Support left trigger and shoulder button for teleporting/shooting
- Added bats on the start screen
- Updated dog sprite
- Updated some level sprites
- Improved shooting animation for slug
- Fix rare crash when two burnlings are hitting each others with explosions
- Make heal/damage player UI show for a bit longer time
- Small text changes
- You can talk with me in the credits menu?
- Improve shooting animation and teleport animation sprites for player two

Stay awesome!

[i]/ Sebastian[/i]
